content: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language known for readable syntax.
Python is used in web development, automation, data science, and artificial intelligence.
JavaScript is a high-level programming language used to add interactivity and dynamic behavior to websites.
JavaScript runs in web browsers and can also run on servers with environments such as Node.js.
SQL is a language used to query and manage relational databases.
HTML is used to structure content on web pages.
